answer_1.quote: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have been endowed with the capability to engage in complex, image-based dialogues with humans, while also being proficient in resolving a series of visual-language tasks.
answer_1.outputs: generated captions and responses in vision-language tasks

answer_2.quote: CHAIR s = |{hallucinated objects}| / |{all mentioned objects}|, CHAIR i = |{captions w/ hallucinated objects}| / |{all captions}|

answer_3.quote: GPT4-Assisted Visual Instruction Evaluation (GAVIE) ) is an approach to measure the hallucination without the need for human-annotated ground-truth answers. GPT-4 takes the generated captions with bounding box coordinates as the image content and compares human instructions and model response. Then, ask GPT-4 to score the answers based on two criteria: (1) Accuracy: whether the response hallucinates with the image content. (2) Relevancy: whether the response directly follows the instruction.
